timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Can you tell us a little bit more about your background history and experience and how you got affiliated with the local 638?
Okay, I was born in Manhattan and I grew up in Queens.
When we were growing up, everyone knew if you got a union job, that you would be better off.
So every time there was an application or apprenticeship program that was open, we lined up for days to sign up.
And there was no different than the Enterprise Association of Steam Fitters.
I signed up, I lined up, I waited, and it took a few months, but luckily I was called to come in to take an exam.
I took the exam, then after that I was called in again, and I came in and I started the apprenticeship.
And I was very fortunate. Not everyone gets accepted in.
From there, I had about a decade in the field working as a mechanic and an opportunity presented itself to me as an organizer for this association.
So I said, if I get this opportunity, I'm going to bring it to as many people as possible.
